_comment:
Codex hook bindings. Per codex-rs/hooks/src/engine/discovery.rs, Codex discovers hooks from hooks.json in each config-layer folder (NOT from config.toml — which has no [hooks] key). This file is the canonical carrier; install.ts writes a copy to ~/.codex/hooks.json at install time so per-user Codex sessions pick them up.

Per PR 6.3 research: HookHandlerType::Prompt and ::Agent are declared in codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs but the engine config parses them as empty-struct variants and the dispatcher hardcodes HookHandlerType::Command. Every entry below uses the default 'command' handler type until upstream lands concrete schema + execution paths.
